title: Paired movement exposes signed motion inputs with byte-encoded storage
claim: sub_08028270 is 688 bytes of new matching C implementing ten primary entities and five paired peers through eight directional states. Ordinary entity array pointers preserve the exact code. Phase zero in state one is independent of the following phase chain; the other directional states use a single chain. No new pins or assembly fallbacks were introduced.
